name: Hina-chan no Utagoe
source:
Main character is a teacher who has just got a licence and found a job in a girls school in his home town. There is a girl who allows him to do whatever he wants, but there is also his ex-girlfriend who demands his attention after all these years. All he needs is choose.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位刚刚拿到执照并在家乡的一所女子学校找到工作的老师。有一个女孩让他为所欲为，但也有一个时隔多年仍需要他关注的前女友。他所需要的只是选择。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
